result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The full test suite passes. I didn't add a test for the cancelled case, so your Anna/Bob example hasn't been run.

In `DataStore.java`, I added an `ACTIVE_PURCHASE_ORDERS` constant to the `CustomerAttributedRecords` enum. It has the same query as `PURCHASE_ORDERS` plus `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`. `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` now uses it. Reps with no purchase orders still show 0, and the ordering is unchanged.

I left the per-country purchase-order count on the old `PURCHASE_ORDERS` constant, since you only mentioned the per-rep report. It still counts cancelled purchase orders. If you want it to match, switch `findPurchaseOrderCountPerCountry` to the new constant too.
